draft.shortGloss: to work; to do; to make
draft.emotion: focused and steady, a sense of purposeful daily activity
notes: Takes فِي (fī, 'in/at') for a workplace and كَـ (ka-, 'as') for a profession, or the accusative case (e.g. عَمِلَ مُعَلِّمًا 'he worked as a teacher').
For 'to do', فَعَلَ (faʿala) is more general in standard Arabic, whereas عَمِلَ focuses on putting in effort or performing a task.
